# For Global Variable

Source: [4383](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4383); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [For Global Variable](../../api/actions/for-global-variable.md).

<a id="wiki-4383-n1"></a>

- For uses an exclusive stop bound: it exits when the control variable reaches or passes Range Stop, including before the first iteration.

<a id="wiki-4383-n2"></a>

- Direction of passing depends on Step sign; Step is added when End executes.
